snippet.title: HexWind VR - Metal Release Trailer
snippet.description:
HexWind is a magical combat roguelite experience that lets players harness time-slowing mechanic to defeat apparently insurmountable hordes of foes!

Now available on Steam VR and Meta.

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2739340/HexWind/
Meta Quest: http://meta.com/en-gb/experiences/hexwind/26095401800073641
